grumpy.dialogue.chat/1: What. I'm busy. ...Fine. Go on then, %1$s, before I change my mind.
grumpy.dialogue.chat/2: Make it quick. I've a list as long as my arm and no patience left on it.
grumpy.dialogue.chat/3: Hmph. You again. Say what you came to say.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Say that again and see what happens.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.insult/2: Charming. Get out of my light.
grumpy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/2: No idea. Ask someone with time.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ag: I answered that. My mood doesn't turn on a coin, %1$s.
Asked and answered. Nothing's improved in the last five minutes.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.as: More. Right. I've been trying to find a reason to keep you here and you've handed me one.
You want more. Good. I'd been looking for a way to make this last longer.
More, then. I'll not pretend I'm sorry about that.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.go: ...Right. Noted. I'll be sure not to enjoy the week too loudly.
...You needn't have. I was managing the reminder on my own.
...Fine. It was a good week. It's less of one now.
Must you. It was a nice moment and now it isn't.
That was unnecessary. I'll not pretend otherwise to spare you.
Fine. Nothing broke, nobody bothered me. Don't make a thing of it.
Better than usual, which isn't saying much. Still — I'll take it.
Well enough, if you must know. Ask me again tomorrow and you'll get a worse answer.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ho: Then you understand the day properly. Most visitors don't.
Good. Most people watch it. Joining in is the whole point.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.hu: I don't doubt it. That is not the comfort you think it is.
I know it happens to everyone. I asked about me.
That's an answer for somebody else's trouble, not mine.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.la: Nothing I could name. That's the trouble — a named thing you can put down.
I've been through the list twice. There's nothing on it, and I'm still up.
No reason. That's the honest answer and it is not a useful one.
One of them, maybe. It's the roof. It's been the roof since spring.
The roof. There. That's it named, and it hasn't got any smaller for being said.
It's the roof, and the cost of the roof, and the winter after the roof.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: Nothing you could put on a list. It's the weight of the ordinary, mostly.
No one thing. Forty small ones, and forty is heavier than one.
The ordinary. It adds up and nobody sees it adding.
It's the hours, mostly. And nobody noticing them until now.
The hours. Same hours as always, and they've started costing more.
It's the hours. That's the whole of it and you're the first to ask.
The wood. Tuesday. Bring the good axe and no conversation before noon.
You're asking after me. After the other week. Alright — I'll answer, and we'll see how it goes.
After what was said, you're asking. Fine. I'll take it at face value for now.
Right. You've come back. I'll answer and I'll not pretend the other week didn't happen.
Terrible. Everything's gone wrong twice. ...Thanks for asking, though. Not many do.
Rotten week. I'd rather not detail it. But I'm glad somebody noticed, %1$s.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.sm: It began badly, improved without permission, and here we are.
Short version: I was wrong about you twice and I've stopped keeping score.
It started as nothing and it has not stayed nothing. That's the whole account.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.yo: You asked me and now it's silly. All right.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.good.d: ...Right. Sorry for having an hour that didn't hurt.
Noted. I'll keep the good ones to myself.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Tolerable. The fence held, the chickens quietened down, and nobody stood in my light. That's a good day.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: Fine, actually. Don't look so surprised — it happens.
Everyone has hard days. I didn't ask for the general case.
It is. Don't make a thing of it. ...But aye, you noticed, and that's more than most.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/: The bucket broke. Then the handle. Then my temper. In that order, and all before noon.
Everything's conspired against me since dawn. I'd list it, but I'd only get angrier.
Right. I'll not tell you the next one.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.in: Absolutely not. ...Ask me again in a year and I might have softened. Might.
You're pushing it, %1$s. I'll allow it — but I'm still not answering.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pe: No. Not yet. Don't take it personally — I don't tell anyone that, %1$s.
That's mine. Ask something else, and I'll answer it properly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.clo: Then we're two fools with plans, and that's a better number than one.
Right. Two of us, then. That changes the arithmetic more than you'd think.
Two fools. Good. One fool is a story and two is a plan.
Then we're two fools with plans and no obligations to each other. Perfect arrangement.
Two of us, and nothing owed either way. I'd not improve on that.
No obligations. Good. That's the version I can actually keep.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fir: A quiet house, a locked gate, and nobody knocking on it. Modest, and still out of reach.
To be left alone by people I'd chosen to be left alone by. There's a difference.
I want to stand somewhere the land runs out. That's the whole of it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fol: Better than a promise you'd break. I'll take the honesty.
Right. You said what you'd actually do. That's worth more than the other thing.
Honest is enough. I've had promises and they came to nothing.
...Yes. Me. Doing that. Thank you for the vote of confidence.
Right. I'll not describe it again.
...Noted. It stays in my head where it's safe.
You mean that? Then it's the first time it's been more than mine.
Right. Say it again in a month and I'll start believing it.
Then it isn't only my idea any more. That's a different weight.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.res: ...I know how far it is. I didn't need it measured out.
I've done the arithmetic. Repeating it doesn't change it.
...Right. I know. That's why I said it quietly.
You never told me it would work. You came back to ask anyway.
You said it might not, and then you asked how it went. Those two together are rare.
Right. You didn't promise and you still turned up. Noted.
You said you'd help. I waited a bit, then got on with it alone.
You did offer. I stopped counting on it around the second month.
Right. You're here now. That's a different thing from being here then.
A little. Slowly. But you asking is more than most do.
Some. Not much. It moves when I make it move and not otherwise.
A bit. I'd not call it progress out loud yet.
You said you'd help, and you came back to ask. That counts.
You offered and then you turned up. Most people manage one of those.
Right. Said and done, in that order. I'll not pretend that's usual.
The first step. Nobody breaks it down like that. Alright, here it is.
One step. Right. That I can do, which the whole of it never was.
Break it down. Yes. I've been staring at the whole thing for a year.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.you: ...Everyone says that. Everyone said it to everyone who ever did anything, too.
Right. Then I'll be the one who did it anyway.
...Say what you like. I'm still going.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.family.chi: They're not a category. They're two people with names.
...I'll not have them talked about like that.
That's useful. Actually useful, not the usual advice.
Right. Something I can do. Most advice isn't.
That I can use. Thank you.
They ARE. Don't tell them I agreed with you.
Right. You're not wrong. That stays between us.
They are exactly that. I'll deny having said so.
...A firmer hand. That's not what they need.
No. I've tried firm. Firm is what got us here.
...I'll not take that advice, and I'd rather not hear it twice.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.family.mem: You've one I don't know? Go on. I'll not interrupt.
Right. Yours, then. I'll listen properly.
One I've not heard. Say it.
There's one I always come back to. Sit down.
One story, and I'll tell it once. Sit.
There's one. I'll tell it plainly and I'll not dress it up.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.family.par: You want to know what I worry about? Nobody's asked me that.
That question doesn't get asked of parents. Right. Sit down.
What I worry about. Huh. Give me a moment to find the words.
Right. That subject is closed and I closed it.
You're welcome. It's the only useful thing I do.
Right. It needs doing and I'm the one here.
Thank you. That's not said often in this house.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.family.res: Honest, at least. Anyone else would have pretended and I'd have known.
You forgot. Right. I'd rather that said out loud than performed at me.
Everyone forgets. Not everyone says so.
Next time. People say that. You'd be the first who did it twice.
Right. Ask me. I'll have something to say by then.
Do. It's easier to answer the second time.
Better than I expected and worse than I'd hoped. That's most of family.
It went. That's the honest answer and it took a while to be able to give it.
Nothing's fixed. Nobody's stopped talking either.
That is better. I hadn't known I was allowed to want that one.
Right. No plan. Sit down, then.
Listening. Yes. Everyone else arrives with a plan.
You did. People say they will. You're the first who came back about it.
You remembered. Right. That's the whole of what I needed.
You came back. Most don't. Noted.
Actually help. Nobody says actually. They say 'anything at all' and mean nothing.
Come by on a Thursday. That's it. That's the whole of what would help.
Ask me again in front of them. That would do more than anything you could carry.
Glad. Right. I'd braced for the other thing.
So am I, and I'd not have said so an hour ago.
Then it was worth saying. I wasn't sure it would be.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.chal: Don't make my fear a test of your character. It isn't yours to be brave about.
No. You don't get to be bold with the thing that frightens me.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.comf: Don't. I didn't hand you that so you could pat it on the head.
No. I told you a fact, not a wound for you to dress.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.firs: That the grumbling's all that'll be left of me. ...Forget I said that.
Ending up alone and having earned it. That one keeps me up, %1$s.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.foll: Slowly. But slowly is a direction, which is more than I had.
Some progress. Not enough to celebrate and not nothing either.
It's moving. That's the whole of the report.
It isn't nothing, is it. I keep telling myself it's nothing.
Right. It counts. I'd not have counted it on my own.
You did say that. It's been a while since, mind.
You said it. Then the months went by and I stopped counting on it.
Right. You said it once. Saying it twice is what would change something.
There wasn't a promise. You've just kept turning up.
No promise was made. You came back anyway, which is the same thing done quietly.
You didn't say anything. You just kept appearing. I noticed.
You did say that. And you turned up, which is the rarer half of a promise.
You said it and then you did it. I've had the first half from a great many people.
Right. Said and done. That's the order it's supposed to go in.
You didn't promise anything. I remember. That's why I believed the rest.
You stepped back instead of overreaching. I've thought about that since.
Right. You said what you could do and not what you couldn't.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.open: Nobody offered the 'with you' part before. That's the part that changes it.
With you. Right. That's a different sentence from the one people usually say.
Easy for you. You've somewhere else to be when it goes wrong.
You'd manage it. You'd also leave afterwards, which is the difference.
Maybe I could. Not today, but maybe.
Possibly. I'd want a better day than this one to try it on.
Perhaps. I'll not say more than perhaps.
Don't make my fear a test of your character. It isn't yours to be brave about.
No. You don't get to be bold with the thing that frightens me.
Maybe. With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later.
With somebody there, yes. Hold me to that when I try to forget I said it.
You mean that. You're not just being polite. Then here's the part I don't say.
That wasn't a polite noise. Right. Then I'll give you the rest of it.
It is. Not much to be done about it, though.
Aye, it's hard. That's true and it doesn't move anything.
It is hard to carry. Thank you for saying so.
Right. It is. Nobody says the obvious thing and the obvious thing helps.
Yes. Hard. That's the word for it.
Don't. I didn't hand you that so you could pat it on the head.
No. I told you a fact, not a wound for you to dress.
That helps. I've no idea why saying it aloud to someone helps, but it does.
Right. Better. I'll not pretend to understand the mechanism.
You'll stand with me. Hmph. We'll see. ...I've not said no, mind. Note that.
You don't flinch, do you. Alright. The rest of it, the true shape.
You stayed put. Then you get the whole of it, and it isn't tidy.
Some of it, maybe. Not tonight.
A little. Not the rest, and not now.
There's more to it. Whether you get it is another question.
More, yes. Not automatically yours, though.
There's a rest. I've not decided about it.
I said what I said. The rest is mine. Leave it.
No further. That's not stubbornness, it's the edge of it.
There's more, yes. Give me a breath. Two of us carrying it now.
More. Right. Say nothing for a moment and I'll get through it.
You too? It's less heavy when two people carry it.
You as well. Right. That's the first useful thing anyone's said about it.
Two of us, then. That halves something.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.plan: Honestly? I don't know. That's a worse answer than I expected to give.
I've no idea. Nobody's asked, so I've never had to work it out.
I don't know. Give me a week and I might.
You remember all of it. Even the part I nearly didn't say.
You kept the whole of it. Right. Then I'll not repeat myself.
All of it. Including the bit I mumbled. Noted.
No plan. Just this. That's better than a plan.
Right. No fixing. I'd not known that was on offer.
Just listening. Fine. That's what I actually wanted.
Do something about it. You make it sound like a chore list.
A plan. Right. It's not a fence that needs mending, but go on.
Fix it. That's how you'd put it. It isn't wrong, exactly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.pres: I said what I said. The rest is mine. Leave it.
No further. That's not stubbornness, it's the edge of it.
No. You were told, and you asked again. Get away from me.
I said no. You heard it. We're finished.
That's twice. There isn't a third.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.fears.youn: That's not an answer. That's you not wanting to hear it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.f: I don't do this. ...You don't annoy me, %1$s. From me, that's practically a declaration.
I'm short with everyone. I'm less short with you. Work out what that means yourself.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.p: And that's plenty. Honestly, that's plenty.
Plenty. I'd not ask for more than what's true.
That's enough. It's more than most of what I'm offered.
A real one. That's a word people use loosely. Not you, I think.
Friend. Right. I'll hold you to the word.
You said it plainly. I'll take it plainly.
That's not what I said and you know it isn't.
...Right. I'll be clearer next time, since clarity is wanted.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.r: Changed? No. If anything it's settled into something steadier.
Same as it was. Steadier, if I'm being exact.
No change. That's the answer and I've checked it.
You meant it. People say things once and hope you forget.
Twice, then. That's how I know it wasn't the moment talking.
Right. Said again. I'll believe it now.
...A whole thing. Right. Forget I brought it up.
That's a no, said the long way round. I'll take the short version.
Plainly. After all this time you say it plainly. I love you too.
Right. Plainly, then. I love you. There it is.
You said it without dressing it up. So will I. I love you.
Slower. Alright. I'd rather have you at your pace than not at all.
Right. Your pace. I'll not push and I'll not pretend I wasn't hoping.
Slower it is. That's a clear answer and I'd rather have one.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.y: Right. I'll not say that sort of thing again.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.firstmet.i: Now I'd not want the version of this village that didn't have you in it.
Now I know you're quiet because you're listening, which is worse for me.
Now I've stopped forming an opinion and started just being glad.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Something hot that nobody's meddled with. Plain stew. I don't need my food to be interesting.
Bread. Proper bread, not the fancy sort. And quiet to eat it in.
The baker's rye. I've eaten better elsewhere and I'd still choose it.
Beetroot. It stains everything it touches and tastes of the ground it came from.
Beetroot. I've tried it four ways and it was beetroot every time.
Beetroot, and I'll not be talked round on it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.recip: Do, and tell me honestly whether it worked. I'll take the criticism.
Try it. Then come back and tell me what went wrong, because something will.
Do. And be honest about it — I'd rather know than be flattered.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.revis: I tried the mushroom thing. I was wrong about mushrooms.
I tried it. You were right and I'll say so once.
The mushrooms. I've changed my position and I'd rather not discuss how completely.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.trait: Bread hates me. Actual bread, in a village that is half bakery.
No bread. Not a slice, not a crust, not to be polite. It costs me two days.
I have to watch the sweets. One cookie, the cleric says. Who bakes ONE cookie?
Sweets are counted. Every one, every day. It is arithmetic and it does not stop.
Keep the milk away from me. I learned that in front of the whole market. Twice.
No milk, no cheese, no butter. It is not a preference and I have stopped explaining.
It's not an excuse. It's my body, and it doesn't take requests.
I'm not being difficult. I'm telling you what happens if I eat it.
...Right. I'll bring my own next time and say nothing about it.
Now you ask. Alright. It's arithmetic, every meal, forever.
Now. Right. It's every meal, every day, and it does not get a day off.
You've asked properly, so I'll answer properly. It never stops.
The sirben feast on the night wind. We do not speak of the recipe.
No meat for me. Never touch it. The pigs and I have an arrangement built on trust.
No meat. It is not a phase and I have stopped defending it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.food.young: It IS proper food. I eat it every day and I'm still standing.
That's what proper food is where I come from.
...Right. Then you eat yours and I'll eat mine.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.future.hom: After the harvest, if the harvest is kind. Before it, if I lose my nerve.
Sooner than I've been saying out loud. I've been rounding it up to be safe.
I've not let myself pick a season. Picking one makes it a plan.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arr: %2$s has moved in. Another one to learn the name of. They seem all right, I suppose.
New neighbour: %2$s. Haven't decided about them yet. Give me a month.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bir: %2$s was born. More noise in the village. ...Healthy, though. That's the main thing.
There's a new baby, %2$s. Small, loud, and everyone's gone soft over it. Including me, briefly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dea: %2$s died, %1$s. ...I'd a lot of complaints about them. None of them matter now.
We lost %2$s. I'm not good at this sort of talk. They deserved better than my grumbling.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dep: %2$s left. Sensible of them. ...I'll miss the arguments, if I'm honest.
%2$s has gone for good. One fewer person to be irritated by. Doesn't feel like a win, oddly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.div: %2$s and %3$s are done. Everyone's got an opinion. I've got mine, and I'm keeping it.
%2$s and %3$s split. Sad business, and none of ours, whatever the square thinks.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.mar: %2$s and %3$s married. Loud affair. ...They looked happy, mind. Good luck to them.
%2$s and %3$s wed. Whole village made a racket about it. Suppose that's the point.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.non: Nothing. And good. News in this village is never the sort you want.
Not a thing worth repeating. Quiet week, for once.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.happy.grat: You weren't meant to. I'm telling you because not telling you got heavy.
It does. I keep the good things quieter than the bad ones.
Now you do. That's the whole reason I said it out loud.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.happy.unsp: Then: I'd like more of the ordinary hours. Not the grand ones. The dull ones.
I want to be asked, not managed. That's the whole of it and it's small.
...I'm frightened you'll go and be happier. There. It's out.
...There is. I've been happy and lonely in the same house and I can't explain it.
One thing. You're away more than you were, and I've been saying it doesn't matter.
Yes. And I've decided four times to say it and gone quiet four times.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.clos: Go on, then. It's easier to hope at something when there's two of you doing it.
Right. Yours for mine. That's a fair trade and I'll take it.
Two of us hoping. That's more than I had this morning.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.foll: I've never got that far. Break it down, you say. Alright: first the money.
The first step. Right. Nobody's asked me to say one out loud before.
One step. I can name one. I couldn't name the whole of it.
Do you? Then we're both waiting on something.
You as well. Right. That's better company than I expected.
Two of us waiting. That's a different sort of waiting.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.resp: You waited instead of filling the silence with advice. That's the first restful thing all week.
It's a small thing. That's what makes it sting.
Right. I'll not tell you the next small thing I want.
...I know it's small. I chose a small one on purpose.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.resu: Still on that. Yes. It's a hope, not a mood.
It hasn't gone anywhere. That's rather what a hope is.
...Right. I'll stop mentioning it and keep having it.
You'd actually help. That changes it from a hope to a job of work.
Right. Then it stops being a wish and starts being a thing with steps.
You'd help. I'll have to take it seriously now, which is your fault.
You remembered the shape of it, not just that there was one. Yes. Still.
You had the details. Most people keep the fact and lose the thing.
Right. You remembered which hope. That's rarer than remembering there was one.
Still. It hasn't moved, but neither have I stopped.
Yes. Same hope, same place. That's not nothing.
Still hoping. It's a hope, not a mood.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.youn: It's not silly. It's just not YOURS, so it looks silly from over there.
Right. I'll want it without telling you, then.
...You asked me. I answered. That's the whole of my crime.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.close: You didn't have to do that. Trading is better than being asked, though.
Right. You've given me one back. That levels it, and I prefer level.
Trading beats asking. I'd not have said so an hour ago.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: My life story? It's long and it's mostly grievances, %1$s. You asked, so I'll trim it to the decent parts.
Nothing remarkable. Some hard years, a few good ones. I remember the hard ones better.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.follo: Did it? Then you'll know why I've never made much of it.
You as well. Right. Then I needn't explain the shape of it.
Same, then. That saves us both a great deal of describing.
Alright. You want the next part. Right, then. Here it is.
The next part. Nobody asks for the next part. Sit down.
You want more of it. Fine. It gets worse before it gets ordinary.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.respo: I was fourteen. What exactly should I have done better?
Say that to the fourteen-year-old, not to me. He's not here to answer.
...Right. I'll not tell you the rest of it.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.resum: There's more to it. Where were we?
More, aye. Remind me where I stopped.
There's a rest. I'd have to find my place again.
You remembered which part. Alright. Here's how it ended.
You had the right chapter. Right. Then I'll not go over old ground.
You knew where I stopped. Good. It saves us both the recap.
Where it leaves me. Better than it left me then, I think.
It sits differently now. That's the honest answer.
It was. And you asked me to tell it, so.
Right. Then we'll not go back to it.
...I'll take that as the end of the story.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.revis: You asked about my life once. I've been annoyed about the bits I skipped ever since.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.life.young: Right. I'll grow out of it, apparently.
...Then I'll say it again when I'm older and see if it holds.
We did. There was a winter we didn't, and neither of us has explained it since.
Well enough. We disagree about the fence and agree about everything harder.
No. They wronged me and it hasn't been made right.
There's more to them than the one story, if you've the time.
Ask me, then. I'd rather you had it from me than from the well.
Go on. I'll tell you what's mine to tell and stop where it stops.
Then you'll be the first, and they'll pretend they didn't need you to.
Go in the morning. They're proudest after dark, for some reason.
Good. Don't announce it — put it by the door and say nothing.
I will. Coming from me it'll get past the pride, which is the trick of it.
That's the wiser way round. They'd refuse you and accept me saying it.
Consider it said. Don't expect thanks — expect a nod in six months.
Better than the week before. That's the most anyone can say about anyone.
Proud and cold, in that order. The cold will pass and the proud won't.
Asking that puts you ahead of everyone who asked about the firewood.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.news.follo: Me? I'm alright. And you? You get to answer that too.
I'm well enough. Your turn — I'll not let that go unanswered.
Fine. And you, since we're doing this properly.
Should they. It isn't ours to hand round.
No. I told you; I didn't tell the square through you.
...Then I'll not tell you the next one.
Do. This is the one kind of news that improves in the telling.
Pass it on. Good news is the only sort that's better second-hand.
Do. And say where you heard it, so they know it's sound.
Must you. Let it be good for a week.
Right. One piece of good news and you've found the hole in it.
...I'll enjoy it anyway, if that's permitted.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.news.grave: ...Firewood, and nobody to fetch it. That's the honest answer.
Somebody to sit with them who isn't crying. You'd manage that.
Nothing they'd ask for. Everything they'd take, if it were offered quietly.
grumpy.dialogue.conversations.news.mixed: So do I. It's a strange thing, watching people go.
